svg.desc: All panels display the identical training specimens in millimeters and grams. Colors and circle/triangle markers redundantly indicate two-center memberships ordered by center mass, X marks centers, and dashed lines show first principal directions. The middle computation converts grams to milligrams before using raw Euclidean distances. The right computation standardizes using training means and scales, which removes this arbitrary unit-conversion effect. Cluster numbers are not known scientific classes.
svg.title: PCA directions and cluster groups depend on feature metric
